title: The cow in the sunny field
body: On a sunny afternoon, Meena and Ravi walk past a field where a cow is grazing. Meena says, "Look at this cow standing in the Sun. It is getting its energy directly from the Sun." Ravi replies, "Standing in the Sun does not give it energy. The cow is eating grass. The grass leaves need sunlight to grow. So the main source of energy is the Sun, and the cow gets its energy from the Sun through the grass." Their teacher says that plants get energy from the Sun and produce food, animals eat plants and grow, and we get food from both plants and animals.
